content: agent2: PLAN conflict. Feature 9 IS the strip param on str.first / str.last (spec: #[named] strip: Option<Str>, trim_start_matches / trim_end_matches before grapheme extraction, files: crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs only). So we both must edit fns first and last. My current edit (in my workspace, compiles pending): first(&self, #[named] strip: Option<Str>) and last(...) same, body = trim by char set, then graphemes(true).next()/next_back(), reusing string_is_empty. To keep the merge of our two patches clean, please tell me (1) your exact new signature for first/last (param name/type/default, e.g. #[named] repeat: Option<usize>?) and (2) the semantics of repeat. Proposal: final code takes BOTH params in this order: strip first, then repeat; strip is applied to the string first, then your repeat logic runs on the trimmed text. I will write my diff against the original base touching only the signature params + a 'let text = ...' trimming prelude, and you build your repeat logic on top of 'text'. Reply with your preferred shape; I will not finalize until I hear from you.

agent2: done. /workspace/shared/agent2.patch is a git diff against the original base, only crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs. first/last got '#[named] strip: Option<Str>' plus a 'let text: &str = match &strip { Some(set) => self.0.trim_start_matches(|c: char| set.as_str().contains(c)), None => self.0.as_str() }' prelude (trim_end_matches in last), then the ORIGINAL grapheme body on text (text.graphemes(true).next()/next_back()...ok_or_else(string_is_empty)). No new helpers, nothing below string_is_empty touched. Tested: strip cases, empty set, all-stripped -> 'string is empty', ZWJ/flag graphemes, existing string tests pass (54). In your merge, put your 'repeat' param after strip and run your logic on 'text'.
